title: VMware releases security updates for multiple products
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-294.031820: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY- VMWARE RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES FOR MULTIPLE PRODUCTS
leadParagraph: VMware has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
VMware has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

TT-CSIRT encourages users and administrators to review VMware Security Advisories VMSA-2020-0004 and VMSA-2020-005 and apply the necessary updates:

  • https://www.vmware.com/security/advisories/VMSA-2020-0004.html
  • https://www.vmware.com/security/advisories/VMSA-2020-0005.html
